info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides functionality to retrieve information regarding the expiration of hotel loyalty points. By accessing this endpoint, users can obtain a list of loyalty points that are approaching their expiration date, thereby enabling better management of rewards. Typical consumers of this API include hotel loyalty program members and customer relationship management systems that aim to offer timely notifications to members. This ensures that customers can maximize their loyalty benefits and reduce the risk of losing earned rewards.
